svg.title: Invite CoachIQ: Apple account checklist
svg.desc: Confirm an active Organization membership. In App Store Connect, use Users and Access, People, plus. Invite dev@coachiq.io with Admin and Certificates, Identifiers and Profiles access. Confirm acceptance with CoachIQ.

g.text: Invite CoachIQ to your Apple team
Before you invite: active Organization membership
An Individual membership does not provide the developer-team access we need.
App Store Connect → Users and Access → People → +
Send the invitation, then confirm acceptance with CoachIQ.
Use the correct business team. Keep your Apple password and verification codes private.
Illustrated checklist • Not an Apple interface screenshot
